purpose.zh: 练胸部和手臂，增加推的幅度
purpose.en: Build the chest and arms through a deeper push-up.

text.zh: 胸口下沉到双手之间，肘约45°夹向身体
text.en: Sink your chest between your hands with elbows about 45 degrees in

text.zh: 推起后手臂锁直，肩胛向前推
text.en: Lock your arms at the top and push your shoulder blades forward.

text.zh: 身体保持一条直线，不塌腰
text.en: Keep your body in one straight line without sagging.

commonErrors.en: Going so deep that the shoulders roll forward.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.

cautions.zh: 先做手腕热身；手腕刺痛或发麻就停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first, and stop if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
